posts.title: Please don't tell me how to feel.
posts.description: Maybe I'm being sensitive but why must every video or piece of content have emotional music in the background trying to force me to have some intended emotional response? Let me feel how I want I don't need the extra kick.

posts.title: Finch
posts.description: I wish I could bake the imagery into my mind. Don’t forget. That little beak, made for eating seeds, open close open close. Don’t forget. Covered in blood. Open close, open close. Batman came bursting into the room early this morning with that muffled meow that says “I’ve caught something”. He gives it over quite happily, a gift. posts.title: The Dream
posts.description: I had a dream about him last night. You were in the kitchen of our home, saying "he's back, he's outside! He's in the garden! He must have jumped over the wall." I was down the passage in the bedroom, lying on the bed. "No it can't be. It can't be. We went and saw the body. We saw the body!" I've cried every night this week.
